Overview

Coventry is a city in England with a population of 371,000. A historic Midlands city known for its magnificent cathedral, automotive heritage, and the University of Warwick’s innovation district. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
